notes.problem: A mid-tone macro of beige thermoplastic over most of the lower 60 percent, no single subject, no stop bar.
notes.fix: Yaw the camera about 35 degrees so the bars recede diagonally to the stop bar and the lit terracotta kerb panel; keymask the nearest bar's top into shadow.

notes.problem: At a 0.28 m eye the bars read as tan planks about 30 cm thick, a broad mid-tone band, no kerb, stop bar or figure for scale.
notes.fix: Raise the camera to about 1.0 m at the kerb with the warning panel's edge and the stop bar in the near foreground; narrow the light so only the chamfers catch it and the tops fall dark.

notes.problem: At 432 px the paint-height macro reads as abstract beige bands, half the lower frame in the grey middle, the nearest bar under the footer with a visible dark plate behind the cite and site line.
notes.fix: Raise the eye to about 0.6 m and yaw toward the kerb so the warning panel and stop bar enter the left third; tighten the pool to the two nearest chamfers; stop the foreground bar short of the footer band.

notes.problem: A thin tan mid-tone pan under a dead upper middle; the bars start at different x.
notes.fix: Drop the camera to about 0.9 m and move in until the pan fills about 60 percent of the height; darken the concrete; start both bars on one lit zero saw cut.

notes.problem: A tan board across the middle band with a featureless cylinder curb; thin cream ribbons; brown mid tones; no subject fills a third.
notes.fix: Drop the concrete albedo near the asphalt's value and darken the curb so the bars and lit tick walls are the only bright values; dolly in, keeping a sliver of sky.

notes.problem: The gutter pan is a thin mid-tone slab across a fifth of the frame with an empty lower third; perspective makes the 55 bar 0.83 of the 70 bar instead of 0.79.
notes.fix: Rebuild as a TXBENCH plan relief like slide 2, or a near overhead look-down, filling 40 to 50 percent of the height with both bars from one zero tick, the ratio checked in screen space.

notes.problem: 400 markers alias into texture; the six amber markers are a few pixels each.
notes.fix: Lower the eye to about 1.2 m at fov 30, 4 m back, so the amber markers are large in the foreground.

notes.problem: 400 evenly lit markers read as tan specks at 432 px with no pool; the six amber markers tiny, the close pair nearly merged.
notes.fix: Lower the eye to about 1.2 m at fov 30 so the amber row stands in the near foreground at about three times a white marker's size; light a pool on the front rows.

notes.problem: 400 markers alias into dotted noise at feed size and the six brass officer markers are a thin strip at the bottom.
notes.fix: Bring the camera down to about 1.2 m and forward so the front rows show prism faces; set the six brass markers alone one marker width ahead of the block, two touching; let the rear rows fall dark.

notes.problem: A dead mid-tone kerb wedge over the upper left third, stair-step aliasing on the gutter lip, bars flat quads.
notes.fix: Swing the camera about 8 degrees right so the kerb slab leaves frame except its lit lip; give the bars a visible cast under the declared key.

notes.problem: The kit resident small and mannequin-like in a mostly empty road.
notes.fix: Bring the camera to about 6 m and lower it so the resident stands a third of the frame against the lit crosswalk.

notes.problem: A flat black windshield, a primitive dark body, the plate the brightest object on the car.
notes.fix: Give the glass an environment reflection of the warm seam and drop the plate albedo to mid grey.
